summary: A member's high water counts its trimmed batch head and retired envelopes, so a removal or a rejoin under the name never floors below a sequence peers already hold

schema.detail: No database or claim schema change. The read adds the existing writer_heads and retired_envelopes tables, the same floor sequence allocation already uses.

compatibility.detail: No wire, stored format or claim kind change. After adoption withdrew a trimmed envelope's tombstone, a fleet removal recorded a high water below that envelope and a rejoin under the removed name could start below it; both now use the higher value.

recovery.detail: Nothing stored changes; reverting restores the previous read. A removal already recorded keeps the high water it recorded.
